001: What do you do on the weekends?
I usually go for a run in the park and then I meet up with my friends.
That's great! I prefer something more relaxed, like reading or watching series.
Reading is great, but I find it hard to sit still.
I understand, everyone has their own way of unwinding.
Yeah, the important thing is to enjoy your free time.
002: I'm looking for a new hobby, do you have any ideas?
You could sign up for pottery classes, my sister loves them.
Really? I've never tried it, but it does catch my attention.
You should try it, plus you get to meet really nice people.
Well, it could be a good idea, I'll look for a place near home.
If you want, I'll go with you on the first day.
003: Yes, a lot, but I only take pictures when I travel.
I go out almost every Sunday to take pictures around the city center.
And what do you like to photograph the most?
Old buildings and markets, they have so much life.
I'd love to see some of your photos someday.
004: I haven't touched the guitar in weeks, I don't have time.
That's a shame, you played really well when we studied together.
Thanks, but I've been really swamped with work.
You should pick it up again, even just for a bit on the weekends.
You're right, it relaxes me a lot and I miss it.
Well, go for it, I'm sure you'll get back to your level in no time.
005: Do you feel like coming to a dance class with me on Thursday?
Dance? I've never been very good with rhythm, to be honest.
No worries, it's for beginners and it's a lot of fun.
Okay, but promise me you won't laugh at me.
I promise, it'll be fun, you'll see.
Alright, here I go, even if it's just to try something new.
006: I've started collecting old stamps, you know?
Stamps? I didn't know anyone our age who did that.
It's an inheritance from my grandfather, he had boxes full of them and it sparked my curiosity.
How interesting, and have you found any valuable pieces?
Not yet, but I really enjoy organizing them and learning their history.
Well, you'll have to show me the collection one of these days.
007: How long have you been going to the gym?
About three years, I go three days a week after work.
You can tell you're in shape, it's clear you take it seriously.
It's my time to unwind, even though it was really hard at first.
I've tried it a couple of times, but I quit after a few weeks.
The key is finding an activity you genuinely enjoy.
008: I've joined a book club and I'm thrilled.
That's great! What book are you all reading now?
A mystery novel set in Madrid, I can't stop reading it.
I like that genre, do you accept new people in the club?
Of course, the more opinions, the better. I'll send you the info.
Perfect, I'll sign up without a second thought.
009: Are you still going to cooking classes on Tuesdays?
Yes, and honestly, I'm learning a ton.
And which dish have you liked the most so far?
The vegetable paella, although I still can't get it to turn out like the teacher's.
Well, you'll have to invite me to try it once you master it.
Deal, but give me a couple more months of practice.
010: I don't know what to do with so much free time this summer.
You could learn to swim properly, I started last year.
I've always been a bit embarrassed about it, but I do feel like trying it.
Don't be scared, the classes are very enjoyable and you progress quickly.
Thanks for the advice, I'll look for a pool near home.
If you want, I'll introduce you to my instructor, he's very patient.
